title: 10 Best Carica Papaya Preparations
intro: The best medicinal preparations of Carica papaya are teas, decoctions, tinctures, juices, and capsules, each offering unique benefits for health. Papaya leaves and fruits are commonly used to make teas that aid digestion and reduce inflammation. Decoctions, which involve simmering the herb, are often used to support immune function and treat infections. Tinctures provide a concentrated form of the plant’s active compounds, useful for topical applications or internal use. Juices and capsules offer convenient ways to consume papaya’s enzymes and nutrients, supporting overall wellness and digestive health.
